trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it pops on its own when the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing separate to do for it. Work the rest of this guide — story first, then strands and activities, then the long cumulative counters — and treat this page as your final progress check. If one trophy is holding the platinum back, it will almost always be a cumulative one (250 stunts, 100 WAiNK locations, $250,000 laundered), so start those early rather than leaving them for a final grind.
trophies.kindBasis: Awarded for earning every other trophy on the list.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable on its own: it unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, whenever that happens.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to completion on your main save. Because it is the first mission of the game, the practical advice is simple: do not skip or abandon the introduction, and let the mission finish fully before free-roaming. The official description gives no optional objective or fail condition for it, so nothing more specific can honestly be promised. If you start a second save later, this trophy is earned again there — but for the platinum run, secure it at the start and move on.
trophies.kindBasis: Description names the mission Gone Fishing, the game's opening mission.
trophies.missableNote: Missable-risk (precautionary, not confirmed): the description ties this to the opening mission. An opening mission normally plays once at the start of a save, so earn it on your main playthrough and keep an early save until it pops.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost

There is no separate task hidden in the description: it rewards story progression, not a collectible or a score. Our advice is to play Chapter 1 straight through, learn the map and systems, and resist starting long side grinds until the chapter is done — the activities and strands that feed other trophies open up as the story advances. Keep a manual save at the chapter break in case you want a clean re-entry point later.

This gold trophy is the story's finishing line, and the only preparation the description supports is the obvious one: arrive with the story complete and your characters equipped, and save beforehand so the finale can be replayed or revisited if the game allows it. Do not rush here at the expense of the strands — several strand-finale trophies are easier to tidy before the credits, and the 100% completion gold (A Long Road) will send you back out into Leonida afterwards anyway.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, cumulatively. 'Across all shops' means the total is pooled — there is no need to spend it in one place or in one session. Buy your regular supplies, clothes, vehicle work and property upkeep through shops as you play and the counter climbs on its own; only players who hoard cash and buy nothing will reach the endgame short of it. The description does not list shop types, so simply route your normal purchases through shops rather than any free alternative the game offers.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — the starter data records 8. This trophy is gated by money, not by a window: garages remain on sale, so buy them as your income allows, cheapest first if you want steady progress. It pairs naturally with Dime on the Dollar (laundering income) and with Whip It Good, since garages are where a 100-vehicle discovery habit ends up living. The description does not give prices or locations, so work from the game's property listings and buy the last one the moment you can afford it.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The description names the tool (the Scooter Bros app) and the count (10 vehicles), but not which vehicles qualify, so register broadly: whenever you acquire or use a new vehicle, register it rather than assuming your main car is enough. Ten is a small count that finishes quickly once the app is unlocked — do it early, alongside Whip It Good's vehicle discovery, and this trophy takes care of itself.
